high_level_description: The image shows NASA astronaut Jonny Kim inside the International Space Station's cupola. The cupola is a cylindrical module with large windows that provide a panoramic view of Earth from space. In the background, through the windows, the blue expanse of the Earth is visible, along with some clouds and the curvature of the planet. Jonny Kim is seated comfortably inside the cupola, wearing a blue shirt and khaki pants. He has his arms crossed over his chest and is smiling at the camera, giving a sense of ease and contentment.
